proof: Map each singleton $\{i\}$ to $(i,1)$ and map $\emptyset$ to $(1,0)$.  Every pair is non-clashing: the positive example rules out the empty concept, and $(1,0)$ rules out $\{1\}$.  As there are distinct concepts, size $0$ is impossible.
name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of Singletons plus empty set
